coordinate_convention: [left, top, right, bottom], source pixels; right and bottom exclusive
method: All 68 actual crops compared visually with their source pages. Complete crop sheets and separate native-resolution top, bottom, left and right edge strips inspected; larger sheets also inspected in native-resolution slices. Selected faint marks inspected in enlarged source-context crops. All 68 decoded image sizes, modes and pixel bytes match the recorded source rectangles exactly. No image pixels changed.
approval_scope: Agent visual review only; not human approval and not milestone completion. RECROP_REQUIRED includes source-limited cleanup blockers. cleanup_required is not authorization to erase, retouch or synthesize source pixels.
proposed_rect_policy: No fully source-tested clean rectangular alternative was established for any failed crop; proposed_rect is null rather than guessing. Overlapping handwriting cannot be solved by simply tightening a rectangular crop while retaining all printed content.
metadata_scope: Record IDs, image paths, example/exercise identities, captions and printed source pages checked against source. Chapter Markdown alt text and placement are outside these two report files and were not modified or certified.
